title: Export Presentation (StorylineAndReview)

scenarios.title: Export Presentation applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Export Presentation (BtnExportWizard) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Export filename sanitization and overwrite-path comparison pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The production rules pin: filename components REPLACE whitespace and invalid characters with underscores (a:b*c -> a_b_c, tabs/spaces to underscores, null becomes an empty component - deliberately different from the Asset Library's remove-and-'unnamed' contract), and the overwrite-confirmation path comparison is a case-insensitive full-path check where blank inputs are never equal and relative segments are normalized. ExportWizard delegates both rules.
